scope: 10.2.5 Finder context Cut/Copy/Paste, Terminal clipboard/CLI and drag/drop

host_tests.tests/test-finder-transfers.sh: PASS normal + ASan/UBSan; real FS2 recursive 1100 files, 256KiB streamed copy, 32 write fault cases, cycle/readonly/collision/move/remount checks; real Terminal clipboard and Finder pagination/filepanel
host_tests.tests/test-finder-menus.sh: PASS normal + ASan/UBSan; actual shell Finder/Terminal 12-entry contexts and bounds

checks: Real GUI installer creates TMCBFS2 spanning the actual data partition, imports current live files and account; target was never host-formatted
Installed NVMe boot without ISO authenticates imported account, reads imported file and performs real shared-root CoW restore
Internal native Recovery runs the SAME installer as Reinstalla, verifies FS2 data/snapshots and sealed system; complete data-partition SHA unchanged by reinstall
After reinstall and reboot, imported account, documents and existing snapshot remain usable
Real Terminal cp -R/mv copy and move nested folders; pbcopy/pbpaste exchange actual shared text
Finder context Copy/Paste transfers a real file across distinct Finder windows without deleting source
Finder context Cut/Paste moves a directory with nested files across windows through the real atomic move syscall
Real held-button drag drops a file onto a directory icon, changing the actual filesystem
Real drag to Finder sidebar moves into Desktop
Ctrl-drag across two positioned Finder windows copies rather than moves and generates a non-overwriting collision name
Desktop file icons can be dragged into an open Finder destination, and Finder files can be dropped onto the bare Desktop
Real drag into Terminal inserts a quoted path into the pending command; only an explicit Enter executes it
Terminal Ctrl+Shift+C/V uses shared clipboard while paste only edits input, never auto-executes
Session lock clears the shared clipboard; old Finder/Terminal buffers cannot repaste the previous shared content
Copied/moved folders and drag results persist through a cold installed boot and full data/system verification
